title: 2nd Stopping Place 1st Truth Grandeur And Sublimity

questions.question: What is the name of the first truth in this passage?
questions.answer: Grandeur and Sublimity.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah creates far away in space at the same time?
questions.answer: The stars.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah creates in the same way all around the earth?
questions.answer: Many flowers of the same kind.

questions.question: About how many kinds of plants and animals are mentioned?
questions.answer: More than two hundred thousand kinds.

questions.question: In about how many weeks are these living things cared for in spring?
questions.answer: In five or six weeks.

questions.question: How are these creatures managed in that time?
questions.answer: With order and balance, without mistakes.

questions.question: What season is used as a sign of bringing life again?
questions.answer: Spring.

questions.question: What big earlier event is spring said to remind people of?
questions.answer: The creation of the heavens and the earth.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah makes the earth do?
questions.answer: He makes it turn.

questions.question: What two parts of time does Allah join and trade places between?
questions.answer: Night and day.

questions.question: What hidden thing in people does Allah know too?
questions.answer: The thoughts in their hearts.

questions.question: If all these works are really one work, what does that show about the Doer?
questions.answer: He is one unique and powerful Being.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah’s greatness leaves no room for?
questions.answer: Any partner with Him.

questions.question: If someone gives Allah a partner, what wrong things would that suggest about Him?
questions.answer: Need, weakness, fault, and limits.

questions.question: What does the passage say a sound mind would think about that idea?
questions.answer: It would not accept it.

questions.question: Why is giving Allah a partner called a very serious sin here?
questions.answer: Because it goes against His greatness, glory, and highness.

questions.question: According to the verse in the passage, which sin is not forgiven if a person dies on it?
questions.answer: Giving partners to Allah.

questions.question: What is the title of the second truth?
questions.answer: The all-reaching and complete nature of Allah’s lordly works in the universe.

questions.question: What two things set limits on those works?
questions.answer: Allah’s wisdom and will, and the abilities of the things and places involved.

questions.question: Name two things the passage says cannot share in Allah’s works.
questions.answer: Chance and nature.

questions.question: What does the passage say these things are used as instead?
questions.answer: A covering veil over Allah’s power.

questions.question: How many examples does the passage say will be given for the second truth?
questions.answer: Three examples.

questions.question: What main idea does the first truth teach about Allah?
questions.answer: Allah is great and above having any partner.

questions.question: What very distant part of creation is mentioned first?
questions.answer: The stars.

questions.question: What living thing is used as an example of being spread across east, west, north, and south?
questions.answer: Flowers of the same kind.

questions.question: What does the passage show by saying many things are made at one time and in one way?
questions.answer: That one Creator does them all.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the care of plants and animals in spring?
questions.answer: It is regular, balanced, and free from mix-ups.

questions.question: What number of spring examples is mentioned?
questions.answer: More than a hundred thousand examples.

questions.question: What does spring help prove in front of people’s eyes?
questions.answer: That Allah can bring creation and life again.

questions.question: Besides great things in the sky, what small hidden thing does Allah know?
questions.answer: What people think inside their hearts.

questions.question: Why does knowing heart-thoughts matter in this argument?
questions.answer: It shows Allah’s knowledge reaches everything.

questions.question: What conclusion does the passage make from all these works being one act?
questions.answer: The One who does them is unique and mighty.

questions.question: What does Allah’s high greatness do to the idea of shirk?
questions.answer: It removes it completely.

questions.question: What would calling Allah in need of help do to His perfection?
questions.answer: It would wrongly say He is not perfect.

questions.question: What would saying Allah has limits do to His all-reaching power?
questions.answer: It would wrongly put boundaries on it.

questions.question: What kind of person would never think this is possible, according to the passage?
questions.answer: A person with sound intellect.

questions.question: Why is shirk described as an offense here?
questions.answer: Because it disrespects Allah’s greatness and glory.

questions.question: What warning from the Qur’an is mentioned about shirk?
questions.answer: That Allah does not forgive it, while lesser sins may be forgiven.

questions.question: What is the focus of the second truth?
questions.answer: Allah’s deeds in the universe are complete, all-reaching, and openly seen everywhere.

questions.question: What keeps those deeds within proper measure?
questions.answer: Allah’s wisdom and will.

questions.question: What else helps determine how those deeds appear in things?
questions.answer: The built-in ability of each thing and place.

questions.question: Why can blind force and chance not be the real doers?
questions.answer: Because the works are wise, ordered, and life-giving.

questions.question: If they are not true doers, what role do they have?
questions.answer: They are only tools or a screen by Allah’s command.

questions.question: How many subtle examples does the passage promise next?
questions.answer: Three.

questions.question: What are the two named truths in the marked passage?
questions.answer: Grandeur and Sublimity, and the all-reaching nature of Allah’s lordly deeds.

questions.question: Which truth comes first?
questions.answer: Grandeur and Sublimity.

questions.question: What far-apart things are still created together by Allah?
questions.answer: Stars that are very far from each other.

questions.question: What same-kind living things are made around the whole earth?
questions.answer: Flowers of one species.

questions.question: What two groups of living things are mentioned as being cared for in huge numbers?
questions.answer: Plants and animals.

questions.question: How carefully are they cared for?
questions.answer: In a way that is balanced and without error.

questions.question: What yearly event gives many examples of life being brought back?
questions.answer: Spring.

questions.question: What old event from the unseen does that point back to?
questions.answer: The making of the heavens and the earth.

questions.question: What movement of the earth is mentioned?
questions.answer: Its turning.

questions.question: What change between time periods is mentioned?
questions.answer: Night goes into day and day goes into night.

questions.question: What does Allah know inside people while doing all that?
questions.answer: Their secret thoughts.

questions.question: What does the passage say about these many actions in reality?
questions.answer: They are really one act.

questions.question: If the act is one, how many true doers can there be?
questions.answer: Only one true Doer.

questions.question: What does Allah’s grandeur uproot?
questions.answer: Every chance of having a partner.

questions.question: What four bad ideas would shirk wrongly put on Allah’s attributes?
questions.answer: Weakness, need, fault, and limitation.

questions.question: What does the passage say about a healthy, right-thinking mind and shirk?
questions.answer: It would not see shirk as possible.

questions.question: Why is shirk such a grave sin in this section?
questions.answer: Because it insults Allah’s majesty and glory.

questions.question: What does the Qur’anic warning in this part say about lesser sins?
questions.answer: They may be forgiven.

questions.question: In the second truth, what is said about Allah’s deeds in the cosmos?
questions.answer: They are absolute, broad, and seen everywhere.

questions.question: What human-sounding qualities describe those deeds?
questions.answer: They are balanced, wise, clear-seeing, life-giving, orderly, and firm.

questions.question: Name three false explanations the passage rejects.
questions.answer: Chance, nature, and blind force.

questions.question: What image does the passage use for these rejected things?
questions.answer: They are like a veil or cover.

questions.question: By whose command are they used?
questions.answer: By the command of the glorious Doer.

questions.question: How many examples from Surah al-Nahl are introduced at the end?
questions.answer: Three.

questions.question: What special quality of Allah is highlighted by the title of the first truth?
questions.answer: His greatness and high majesty.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah does for stars even though they are very far apart?
questions.answer: He creates and manages them together.

questions.question: What does the passage say about flowers of the same kind around the world?
questions.answer: Allah creates them together in the same pattern.

questions.question: What huge number of plant and animal kinds is mentioned?
questions.answer: More than two hundred thousand.

questions.question: How long does the passage say this spring work takes?
questions.answer: Five or six weeks.

questions.question: What words show this work is done perfectly?
questions.answer: Regularity, balance, and no confusion or error.

questions.question: Why are the spring examples important for people to see?
questions.answer: They show Allah’s power to bring life and create again.

questions.question: What verse idea about six days is referred to?
questions.answer: That Allah created the heavens and the earth in six days.

questions.question: What daily change in the world is mentioned as Allah’s action?
questions.answer: He brings night into day and day into night.

questions.question: What personal hidden matter does Allah know while running the universe?
questions.answer: The quiet thoughts in hearts.

questions.question: What does all this together teach about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: It is vast and belongs to only Him.

questions.question: Why can no partner be accepted with Allah?
questions.answer: Because His greatness and power cover everything.

questions.question: What would saying Allah needs help wrongly mean?
questions.answer: That His power is not enough.

questions.question: What would saying Allah has a fault wrongly mean?
questions.answer: That His greatness is imperfect.

questions.question: What would saying Allah is restricted wrongly mean?
questions.answer: That His power does not reach all things.

questions.question: What kind of sin is shirk called here?
questions.answer: A very grave sin.

questions.question: What reason is given for its seriousness?
questions.answer: It goes against Allah’s grandeur, glory, and sublimity.

questions.question: What does the Qur’anic warning say Allah may forgive?
questions.answer: Sins less than shirk.

questions.question: What three features of the dominical deeds are named in the second truth?
questions.answer: Their absoluteness, comprehensiveness, and appearing without limit.

questions.question: What limits those deeds?
questions.answer: Allah’s wisdom and will.

questions.question: What else affects how those deeds appear in creation?
questions.answer: The capacities of things and places.

questions.question: Why are chance and blind causes rejected?
questions.answer: Because they cannot make such wise and orderly works.

questions.question: What are these causes compared to in relation to Allah’s power?
questions.answer: A veil hiding it.

questions.question: At the end of the passage, what will be shown next?
questions.answer: Three examples linked to three verses.

questions.question: What is the first truth called in the target passage?
questions.answer: The truth of Grandeur and Sublimity.

questions.question: Which creation in the sky is used to show Allah’s power across huge distances?
questions.answer: The stars.

questions.question: Which earth-wide living example is used to show one pattern in many places?
questions.answer: Flowers of the same species.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah does for many plant and animal kinds besides creating them?
questions.answer: He manages, feeds, gives life, separates, and beautifies them.

questions.question: How many kinds are mentioned?
questions.answer: More than two hundred thousand.

questions.question: How quickly are they cared for each spring?
questions.answer: In about five or six weeks.

questions.question: What is missing from this work, showing perfection?
questions.answer: Confusion, defects, and mistakes.

questions.question: What does spring place before human eyes?
questions.answer: Many signs of coming back to life.

questions.question: What earlier creation does that help people believe in?
questions.answer: The making of the heavens and the earth.

questions.question: What does Allah do with night and day?
questions.answer: He brings each into the other.

questions.question: What does Allah know at the same time as ruling all these things?
questions.answer: The hidden thoughts in people’s hearts.

questions.question: When many mighty works are called one act, what does that mean about the Worker?
questions.answer: He is one.

questions.question: What kind of Being is that Worker described as?
questions.answer: Unique and powerful.

questions.question: What possibility is completely pushed away by Allah’s grandeur?
questions.answer: Having any partner.

questions.question: What would shirk wrongly say about Allah’s strength?
questions.answer: That it has weakness or need.

questions.question: What would shirk wrongly say about Allah’s perfection?
questions.answer: That it has defect.

questions.question: What would shirk wrongly say about Allah’s reach over all things?
questions.answer: That it is limited.

questions.question: What does the passage say right thinking people know about this claim?
questions.answer: They know it cannot be true.

questions.question: Why is shirk such a terrible sin according to this part?
questions.answer: Because it offends Allah’s greatness and glory.

questions.question: What message from the Qur’an is given about shirk and forgiveness?
questions.answer: Shirk is not forgiven, but lesser sins may be forgiven.

questions.question: What is the second truth about?
questions.answer: Allah’s deeds in the universe are complete, wide-reaching, and endless in appearance.

questions.question: What controls and measures these deeds?
questions.answer: Allah’s wisdom and will.

questions.question: What five wrong explanations are rejected in this section?
questions.answer: Chance, nature, blind force, unconscious causality, and the elements.

questions.question: What does the passage say about their real role?
questions.answer: They are only used by Allah as an outward screen.

questions.question: How many examples will be presented after this introduction?
questions.answer: Three.

questions.question: What truth is named first in the marked passage?
questions.answer: Grandeur and Sublimity.

questions.question: What does this section try to prove about Allah?
questions.answer: That He is one and has no partner.

questions.question: What very distant things are still under one rule and creation?
questions.answer: The stars.

questions.question: What same-type plants are mentioned as being made across the whole world?
questions.answer: Flowers of one kind.

questions.question: What two large groups of living things are mentioned together in spring?
questions.answer: Plants and animals.

questions.question: What number shows how many kinds are spoken of?
questions.answer: More than two hundred thousand.

questions.question: What short time shows how quickly Allah does this spring work?
questions.answer: Five or six weeks.

questions.question: What three ideas show this work is done perfectly?
questions.answer: Order, balance, and no mistakes.

questions.question: What does spring become a sign of in this passage?
questions.answer: Resurrection, or life being brought back.

questions.question: What first creation is connected to that sign?
questions.answer: The creation of the heavens and earth.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the earth itself?
questions.answer: Allah makes it turn.

questions.question: What pair does Allah keep changing into each other?
questions.answer: Night and day.

questions.question: What does Allah know that people cannot see in each other?
questions.answer: The thoughts inside hearts.

questions.question: What is the result of all these works being treated as one deed?
questions.answer: They come from one powerful Doer.

questions.question: What does Allah’s majesty leave no opening for?
questions.answer: A partner sharing with Him.

questions.question: What would it mean about Allah’s power if He had a partner?
questions.answer: It would wrongly suggest weakness or need.

questions.question: What would it mean about Allah’s greatness if He had a partner?
questions.answer: It would wrongly suggest fault.

questions.question: What would it mean about Allah’s perfection and fullness if He had a partner?
questions.answer: It would wrongly suggest defect and limits.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the judgment of a sound mind on this matter?
questions.answer: It rejects it.

questions.question: Why does the Qur’an warn strongly against shirk here?
questions.answer: Because it is a huge sin against Allah’s greatness and glory.

questions.question: What is the second truth mainly about?
questions.answer: Allah’s acts of caring and ruling are seen everywhere in the universe.

questions.question: Which two things alone limit those acts?
questions.answer: Allah’s wisdom and will.

questions.answer: The abilities of the things and places.

questions.question: Why can nature and chance not be the true cause?
questions.answer: Because the works are wise, careful, ordered, and full of life.

questions.question: If they are not true causes, how are they used?
questions.answer: As a covering veil by Allah’s command, will, and power.

questions.question: What does the passage say will come next after this section?
questions.answer: Three examples from three verses.
